evidence: Trimethylaluminum (TMA, Al(CH3)3) is one of the most commonly used metal-organic sources in various industries. It is an important precursor for the preparation of III -V compound semiconductors and has been used in catalytic applications for a long time. More recently, TMA has been the main metal precursor for atomic layer deposition (ALD) of high dielectric gate oxide Al2O3 in real device integration.
